summary: One-off transient prod log hashed-join for payment reconciliation (dual-control required)
description:
Issue summary:
Finance (billing team) requests a scoped, one-off query against production packet/logs to reconcile a disputed invoice for customer tenancy 'acme-inc'. The target output is a hashed join of session identifiers to billing line items — no plaintext PII should be returned.

Business impact:
- Customer payment discrepancy blocking reconciliation for March invoices (~$32k)
- Finance needs a tight timeframe (3 business days) to close books for month-end

Requested data:
- Time window: 2026-02-10T00:00:00Z -> 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z
- Tables: prod.packet_events, prod.billing_events (read-only)
- Output: rows with (sha256(session_id) AS session_hash, billing_event_id, usage_tokens, timestamp)
- Max rows: 50k; sampling allowed if result set is >50k

Constraints and safeguards requested by Security/Privacy:
- No plaintext user identifiers, IPs, or request payloads returned
- Use KMS-wrapped ephemeral key for decrypting any necessary lookup table; key access requires two approvers (dual-control)
investigation:
SRE review (2026-03-10):
- Query plan analysis flagged a potential cross-join when joining packet_events -> billing_events on non-indexed fields; estimated cost could scan ~120M rows if run naively.
- Recommendation: add pre-filter on tenancy_id = 'acme-inc' and apply a timestamp range filter before join; ensure join keys are hashed and pre-aggregated to reduce working set.
- Confirmed that prod read-only replica can serve this query, but set a 10m statement_timeout and max_bytes_scanned threshold.
- AccessOps validated that an ephemeral SQL view can be created with limited columns and runtime TTL.

Investigation links:
- Query plan snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/qplan/qp-887
- Error/trace sampling: logs://prod-us-east/packet_events/query/2026-03-10/trace-5582
resolution:
Approval summary (2026-03-12):
- Security: Approved under dual-control after confirming no plaintext identifiers leave the environment.
- AccessOps: Will create an ephemeral, read-only view 'tmp_acme_payment_join_v1' on prod replica and run the parameterized query.
- Execution plan: AccessOps to run the query from jump-host 'audit-bastion-2' with session recorded; results encrypted with KMS and uploaded to restricted S3 bucket 's3://redwood-finance-audit/acme-2026-02' with lifecycle policy to delete after 7 days.
- Audit: All actions logged to audit-log cluster; approvers list captured in ticket history.

Follow-up action items:
- AccessOps run the job and paste encrypted S3 URI here (assigned)
- Finance to validate sample within 48 hours and request any additional slices
- Product Ops to add a short SOP snippet for 'hashed-join payment reconciliation' (confluence link TBD)

Closure criteria:
- Export exists and Finance confirms reconciliation OR Finance raises additional data slices (new ticket).
